description.value: The Junction is an LGBTQ-primary pub situated on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, the heart of the city's queer village. It operates as a full-service bar with a food menu, lounge drinks, and a regular events program including a guestlist system for special occasions. The venue is smoke-free, wheelchair accessible, and offers both indoor and outdoor seating.
